stable.label: native-fluid-projection-v3-ci-pass
stable.note: The active 3D browser route remains the compiler-proven native material/fluid slice. Native body-to-material coupling V2 is promoted on main but isolated from the active browser route. World Weather V1 is promoted on main and both GitHub Pages deployment paths passed. Runtime browser execution and iPhone device execution remain unverified.

active_experience.runtime: from-scratch C++/WASM owns the active 3D material and fluid state; JavaScript only verifies/transfers native state and drives the from-scratch WebGPU volume renderer
simulated_state: native kinetic energy and signed XYZ momentum
deterministic seeded state evolution including velocity/pressure
render_coupling: 3D solid/water density derives from native occupancy
surface normals derive from native field gradients
sand wetness derives from native moisture
water turbidity derives from native suspended sediment
native pressure is dynamics/telemetry and never relabeled as sediment
water shape derives from simulated occupancy rather than animated geometry
approximations: water is coarse binary voxel occupancy
pressure projection is a voxel-scale incompressibility constraint
advection moves water at most one neighboring voxel per substep
ray marching interpolates only for presentation
native body v1 is not loaded by the active browser route
world-weather is a separate promoted route

tests: fresh native C++ projection fixture passes
impulse creates signed momentum and kinetic energy
fixed-seed plus fixed-impulse replay includes velocity/pressure
exact browser payload equals fresh compiler SHA-256
material invariant forbids motion/pressure on non-water cells

native_body_mechanics.numeric_model: signed Q16.16 fixed-point at approximately 120 Hz
mechanics: explicit node mass and inverse mass
approximations: mass-node articulated mechanics, not a complete six-DOF rigid-body inertia-tensor solver
node spheres are collision samples, not final visual geometry
no self-collision, muscle physiology, FEM tissue continuum or active controller yet
not loaded into the active browser route
tests: gravity changes native velocity and position
internal equal-mass constraint correction preserves center of mass
friction impulse remains within configured Coulomb bound and reduces tangential speed
break threshold severs a structural constraint
freestanding WebAssembly has zero imports and exactly matches native reference replay

coupling: WATER is counted but not faked as solid
material removal changes later body support
native and zero-import WebAssembly coupled fixtures agree
native_body_material_coupling.truth: This is API-only coupling of the authoritative solvers. There is still no buoyancy, drag, pressure-force, added-mass, lift, wake or body-driven fluid displacement, so swimming is not claimed.

causal_model: temperature-dependent saturation condenses humidity into cloud
cloud condensate above threshold precipitates rain
rain infiltrates soil or becomes mobile surface water
surface water follows local hydraulic head
persistent concentrated discharge diagnoses river cells
tornado cells require simultaneous resolved vorticity, pressure deficit, cloud, rain and wind
browser_contract: browser reconstructs seven committed payload chunks
SHA-256 is verified before WebAssembly instantiation
model version and 192x128 dimensions must match
Math.random is forbidden from generating simulation state
world_weather.truth: This is a deterministic 2D surface atmosphere/hydrology layer, not DNS, LES, mesoscale NWP or a validated tornado forecast model. It does not claim the full 3D material volume has been expanded to 192x128xdepth. Tornado output is a resolved-field diagnostic and is never directly written by a timer or spawn animation.

native_volume_renderer.truth: WebGPU ray marching is presentation over native 3D state; time-driven fake water-normal animation is forbidden; water normals derive from native water-density gradients and turbidity derives from native suspended sediment, never pressure.

active_objective: Couple the promoted 192x128 atmosphere/hydrology layer to the native 3D material world so real simulated rainfall/runoff enters volumetric water state and volumetric evaporation/topography can feed back into weather.
next_gate: Prove deterministic two-way weather-to-volume water transfer and conservation/error telemetry before resuming hydrodynamic body-force work.
next_scientific_blocker: Two-way world coupling: the high-resolution surface weather layer and 3D material/fluid volume are both causal systems, but rainfall/runoff has not yet been injected into the volumetric material state and volumetric evaporation/topography feedback has not yet been returned to the weather layer.
invariants: committed browser WASM must equal fresh compiler output
weather renderer must read native state rather than inventing simulation motion
tornado state cannot be directly timer-spawned
visual interpolation is not simulation resolution
do not call weather validated NWP/tornado forecasting
do not call fluid validated CFD
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
